jobs.api_description_text:
• 1-year contract, renewable
  • Government project
  • Hybrid work arrangement
Role Overview

The ML/AI Engineer will join the Fraud Analytics Model (FAM) team within the Data Analytics and AI Division (DSAD). The role supports FAM 2.0, which detects misuse of public training subsidies, by designing and building two agentic AI systems.

One system will surface emerging fraud risks and blind spots. The other will help turn validated risks into actionable detection logic. Human validation, evaluation and responsible AI guardrails will be built into both systems.

You will deliver working, evaluated minimum viable products (MVPs) and help build DSAD’s in-house capability to operate and maintain them independently.

Key Responsibilities

  • Agentic AI architecture: Design the end-to-end architecture for FAM agentic AI solutions, including agent orchestration, workflows, state management, tool integration, human approval points and system interactions. Use suitable frameworks such as LangGraph or CrewAI. Architecture decisions will be made in consultation with DSAD’s Platform Team.

  • Emerging-risk agent development: Develop AI agents that analyse approved information sources to identify, generate and prioritise evidence-linked emerging fraud and abuse risks for officer review.

  • Detection engineering agent development: Develop AI agents that assess data feasibility, propose candidate risk indicators and detection features, and support the translation of validated risks into actionable analytics and detection logic.

  • Data and analytics integration: Integrate agent workflows with FAM 2.0 data and analytics components, including Redshift, Glue and PySpark. Build and maintain the data preparation and feature engineering processes needed to support AI and ML workloads.

  • Production engineering: Turn prototypes into modular, tested, maintainable and deployable services, workflows, APIs or agentic applications, with clear interfaces, version control and operational ownership.

  • CI/CD and automation: Build automated workflows to test, validate and promote code, prompts, workflows and AI components across environments. Include quality, security and human approval gates where required.

  • Evaluation and AI guardrails: Implement evaluation frameworks and governance controls covering output quality, reproducibility, traceability, access control, exception handling, human approval and safeguards against untrusted inputs, such as prompt injection.

  • Monitoring and reliability: Implement observability, dashboards and alerts for system health, latency, throughput, errors, resource use, data quality, workflow performance and operating costs. Support incident management, troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.

  • Domain collaboration: Work closely with DSAD data scientists, business users and analysts to capture domain expertise, refine agent workflows and ensure solutions address operational fraud-detection needs.

  • Documentation and knowledge transfer: Produce maintainable code, architecture decision records, evaluation evidence, operational runbooks and technical documentation. Conduct knowledge transfer to support the long-term sustainability of the solutions.

Requirements and Qualifications
Education and Experience

  • Education: Degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related technical discipline.

  • Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience building and deploying ML/AI applications, including at least one LLM-enabled system delivered beyond the prototype stage into operational use.

Essential Technical and Professional Competencies

  • Strong Python software engineering skills, including API development, testing, version control and modular system design.

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying ML/AI applications, including at least one LLM-enabled or agentic AI solution beyond the proof-of-concept stage.

  • Experience with LLM applications, retrieval, tool use, workflow orchestration or multi-agent frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI or equivalent.

  • Experience integrating AI/ML solutions with enterprise data platforms, databases, APIs or cloud services.

  • Ability to design and implement systematic evaluation frameworks for AI systems, including testing, benchmarking, observability and reproducibility.

  • Working knowledge of AI governance, security and responsible AI practices, including human-in-the-loop controls, access management, auditability and safeguards against misuse.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable AI-enabled solutions.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with AWS services such as Bedrock, Redshift, Glue, S3, Lambda or related cloud-native services.

  • Experience with PySpark, Databricks, large-scale data processing or feature engineering pipelines.

  • Experience with CI/CD, containerisation, MLOps or model deployment tools such as Docker, MLflow, GitHub Actions or Jenkins.

  • Experience implementing monitoring, observability and operational support processes for ML/AI applications.

  • Experience delivering fraud-detection, risk, compliance, investigation or decision-support solutions.

  • Experience with knowledge retrieval, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), graph-based workflows, prompt management, model evaluation tools or AI observability platforms.

  • Familiarity with Singapore Government or public-sector technology environments, including data governance, security and compliance requirements.

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams of data scientists, engineers, analysts and business stakeholders.

Soft Skills and Communication

  • Strong engineering judgement and a structured approach to experimentation, with the ability to distinguish a robust MVP from a demonstration.

  • Ability to explain architecture, evaluation evidence, risks and controls to technical, governance and management audiences.

  • Collaborative approach to working with fraud-domain officers. You will design systems that capture their expertise while keeping decisions and accountability with them.

  • Ability to integrate quickly into an existing team and work effectively with limited supervision.

  • Comfort working across research, engineering, integration, documentation and stakeholder engagement.

    /Ref: 309

  • Build and optimise end-to-end RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, focusing on high-precision retrieval and semantic search.

Personal Attributes

We’re on a mission to make financial services accessible and effortless for SMEs. As one of Singapore’s latest digital wholesale banks fully regulated by MAS, we’re committed to continuous innovation to bring about simpler, safer and more rewarding financial services. #bringingaboutwhatsnext


About the Role

We’re building a next-generation digital banking platform with AI at its core, deployed at a regulated bank and serving both employees and real customers.


You will be the hands-on engineer building these systems. Working within a nimble, full-ownership squad, you will build agentic AI products and the platform they run on, turning solution designs into working, production-grade systems that support customer growth and operational efficiency.


We’re looking for a strong backend engineer who has started building with AI, and wants to go deeper.


Job Responsibilities

What You’ll Build

  • Multi-agent workflows: Specialist AI agents that work together on complex tasks, such as analysing information from many sources and assembling the evidence into one case.
  • Customer AI agents: AI agents that help customers directly, answering questions and completing tasks.
  • Agentic banking products: AI powered product that works across customer onboarding, growth and back-office operations.

  • Own what you build end to end: technical design, build, testing, deployment and production support
  • Design agentic AI workflows, including orchestration, state and memory, and the error handling that keeps them reliable

  • Keep business logic in version-controlled, tested services so agent behaviour is auditable
  • Build evaluation suites and take AI products from pilot to full scale
  • Build in guardrails and controls, including access controls, data masking, human-in-the-loop checks and fallbacks, so everything meets the bank’s security, resilience, audit and regulatory requirements and MAS’s Guidelines on AI Risk Management
  • Monitor AI quality, latency and cost in production, and keep improving them
  • Explore the latest AI models, tools and platforms, run proofs of concept, and assess whether they are feasible for the bank, including their value, cost, security and regulatory fit
  • Work closely with operations, compliance and other business teams to turn their day-to-day needs into product features
  • Build reusable components and share them with other squads and our parent group’s engineers


Requirements

  • An understanding of how to test and evaluate non-deterministic AI systems

jobs.api_description_text:
Salary: $10,000 – $14,000 per month

Department: CISO Office
Location: Singapore
Experience: 8+ years preferred

Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on Security Automation Engineer to develop AI-driven security investigation and response capabilities for our Agentic SOC.

The role combines software engineering, cybersecurity operations and agentic AI to automate threat intelligence analysis, detection engineering, threat hunting, security investigations and incident response workflows.

The engineer will leverage Elastic Security, privately hosted LLMs and secure integrations with enterprise security tools to accelerate investigations and strengthen defence against sophisticated APTs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Agentic AI Engineering: Develop AI agents and automated workflows using Elastic Security AI capabilities, agent orchestration frameworks and LLM tool calling.

  • Security Investigation Automation: Build workflows for alert triage, evidence correlation, attack timeline reconstruction and incident prioritisation.

  • Threat Intelligence and Detection Engineering: Develop AI-assisted workflows to analyse emerging threats, generate detection rules, test analytics and support proactive threat hunting.

  • Security Integration: Integrate agents with Elasticsearch, EDR, IAM/PAM, network security systems and threat intelligence platforms using Python, APIs and MCP where appropriate.

  • Incident Response and Forensics: Automate targeted forensic collection and threat-hunting workflows using tools with appropriate approval controls.

  • Sovereign AI: Integrate privately hosted LLM inference services to enable secure processing of sensitive CII telemetry.

  • Agent Security and Reliability: Implement access controls, audit logging, automated testing, agent evaluations and safeguards against unauthorised actions.

  • Operational Collaboration: Work with MDR and IR specialists to continuously improve automated detection, investigation and response capabilities.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong Python development and API integration experience.

  • Experience developing security automation, SOAR workflows or security-focused software applications.

  • Practical experience with LLM APIs, AI agents, tool calling or orchestration frameworks.

  • Understanding of SIEM, EDR/XDR, threat detection, threat hunting and incident response.

  • Familiarity with Elasticsearch, Elastic Security or comparable analytics platforms.

Ideal Candidate

A security-focused software engineer with strong automation skills and practical AI-agent development experience, capable of translating cybersecurity investigation methodologies into secure, reliable and scalable automated workflows.

As an Agentic AI Intern, you will be part of a fast-paced team developing cutting-edge AI solutions, including generative and agentic AI applications. You will contribute to building impactful proof-of-concept (PoC) projects aligned with real client needs, and help develop reusable AI components that accelerate future solution development. This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about AI, eager to learn, and excited to apply both software engineering and machine learning skills in real-world scenarios.

What You’ll Do:
Role Overview: You will contribute to building generative and agentic AI applications, developing reusable AI assets that accelerate solution delivery across the company, and evaluating AI systems for safety, security, and reliability.

  • Develop end-to-end generative AI and agentic AI applications using modern AI frameworks and full-stack technologies.
  • Build reusable AI components such as prompt templates, evaluation pipelines, APIs, and software libraries that can be adopted across multiple projects.
  • Perform AI risk analysis by designing and executing tests to identify issues such as hallucinations, prompt injection, data leakage, unsafe tool usage, and other vulnerabilities in AI agents.

  • Familiarity with software development fundamentals such as APIs, Git, and object-oriented programming.
  • Basic understanding of Linux, Docker, or cloud technologies is a plus, but not required.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an interest in experimenting and building innovative AI solutions.
  • Self-motivated team player with good communication skills and a proactive attitude.

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

Scam Alert

We are aware of fraudulent job offers and impersonations of NCS recruiters. Phishing emails using convincing-looking but fake addresses are also commonly used to trick you into thinking that they come from official NCS sources.

Always check that the sender’s email address ends with the genuine NCS domain, @ncs.com.sg and beware of extra letters, symbols or misspellings. When in doubt, verify the sender’s identity by contacting us at reachus@ncs.com.sg.

jobs.api_description_text:
Job description

We're building a next-generation digital banking platform with AI at its core, deployed at a regulated bank and serving both employees and real customers.

You will be the hands-on engineer building these systems. Working within a nimble, full-ownership squad, you will build agentic AI products and the platform they run on, turning solution designs into working, production-grade systems that support customer growth and operational efficiency.

We're looking for a strong backend engineer who has started building with AI, and wants to go deeper.

Job Responsibilities

What You'll Build

• Multi-agent workflows: Specialist AI agents that work together on complex tasks, such as analysing information from many sources and assembling the evidence into one case.

• Customer AI agents: AI agents that help customers directly, answering questions and completing tasks.

• Agentic banking products: AI powered product that works across customer onboarding, growth and back-office operations.

What You'll Do

• Own what you build end to end: technical design, build, testing, deployment and production support

• Design agentic AI workflows, including orchestration, state and memory, and the error handling that keeps them reliable

• Build and maintain the Java and Spring Boot services, APIs and data/event pipelines that connect our AI to core banking, KYC platforms and customer systems

• Keep business logic in version-controlled, tested services so agent behaviour is auditable

• Build evaluation suites and take AI products from pilot to full scale

• Build in guardrails and controls, including access controls, data masking, human-in-the-loop checks and fallbacks, so everything meets the bank's security, resilience, audit and regulatory requirements and MAS's Guidelines on AI Risk Management

• Monitor AI quality, latency and cost in production, and keep improving them

• Explore the latest AI models, tools and platforms, run proofs of concept, and assess whether they are feasible for the bank, including their value, cost, security and regulatory fit

• Work closely with operations, compliance and other business teams to turn their day-to-day needs into product features

• Build reusable components and share them with other squads and our parent group's engineers

Job Requirement

• Min 5 years of backend software development, with strong production experience in Java and Spring Boot

• Solid understanding of distributed systems and microservices, with experience in public cloud and Kubernetes

• Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agentic AI, such as tool calling, agent frameworks or RAG. Production experience is a strong plus, and serious side projects count

• An understanding of how to test and evaluate non-deterministic AI systems

• Clear communication with non-engineers, including operations and compliance teams

• Proficiency in English and Mandarin, as you'll work with parent-group teams and Chinese-language documents

The Smart Manufacturing and AI team at Micron Technology is looking for an ambitious engineer (Member of Technical Staff | MTS) to deliver industry-winning Agentic AI solutions that power Micron’s dominance in the highly competitive memory solutions market. This role sits at the intersection of applied Agentic AI engineering and production systems work: you will architect autonomous AI Agents and the agentic and data pipelines that power them, build robust CI/CD deployment paths to Kubernetes and containers, and push the limits of agent performance profiling and evaluation to turn massive data and compute into measurable manufacturing impact. Qualified applicants will have experience across data/cloud technologies and systems engineering, with extensive practice modeling data, querying, and deploying scalable pipelines to execute AI agents. You will collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers and expert users to build and deploy scalable Agentic AI solutions that drive value and insight from Micron’s manufacturing processes and systems.

If you enjoy solving hard problems at scale, thrive on turning speculative research into production-grade systems, and want to see your work drive silicon to market, this is the team for you.

Responsibilities include, but not limited to:

  • Design and develop autonomous AI Agents capable of multi-step reasoning, planning, and tool execution to automate complex manufacturing workflows.

  • Implement Agentic frameworks to orchestrate LLM interactions with internal APIs, databases, and software tools.

  • Build and maintain agent evaluation harnesses to benchmark agent accuracy, reliability, and task success across complex, multi-step workflows.

  • Analyze and profile agent and inference workloads (e.g., tool-calling latency, multi-agent orchestration) to identify and resolve bottlenecks in compute and latency, using agent observability and profiling tools (e.g., PyTorch Profiler, LangSmith, OpenTelemetry).

  • Implement interoperable multi-agent systems using the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), including MCP tools, plugins, and skills.

  • Create/maintain CI/CD pipelines for deploying AI Agents to Kubernetes and containerized environments in the cloud.

  • Design and implement security controls for autonomous AI Agents, including sandboxing, access control, and mitigation of prompt-injection and tool-misuse risks.

  • Mentor engineers on agentic system design paradigms and optimization techniques.

Education Qualifications:

Technical Degree required (Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field). Ph.D. is a plus.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Experience optimizing inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM) for autonomous AI Agent and LLM workloads.

  • Experience developing GenAI applications and AI Agents using one or more frameworks. Microsoft Agent Framework or Google Agent Development Kit preferred.

  • Proficiency with Large Language Models (LLMs), including prompt engineering, function calling/tool use, and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning.

  • Experience designing and implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, and vector search.

  • Experience building and operating end-to-end systems that automate the testing, evaluation, and deployment of autonomous AI Agents.

  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools, plugins, and skills, and the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol for building interoperable multi-agent systems.

  • Understanding of AI Agent security practices, including sandboxing, access control, and mitigating prompt-injection and tool-misuse risks.

  • Familiarity with machine learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, etc).

  • Strong scripting and programming skills, with software development skills and a desire to work in a cloud environment.

  • 8+ years of relevant industry experience, spanning large-scale data/ML pipelines and/or production Agentic AI systems.

  • Outstanding analytical thinking, interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills.

  • Ability to prioritize and meet critical project timelines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience with Kubernetes for orchestrating containerized applications, including deployment and scaling of AI Agent workloads.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing and coordinating Multi-Agent Systems, including collaboration between specialized agents.

  • Experience designing and operating agent swarms for distributed, parallelized task execution.

  • Experience with agent profiling and evaluation tooling to identify performance regressions and bottlenecks across agent pipelines.

  • Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or CrewAI.

  • Solid understanding of security protocols, cryptography, PKI, and authentication/authorization frameworks.
  • Experience implementing SIEM/SOAR tools and conducting database configurations and basic queries.
  • Ability to translate complex security solutions into business value propositions
  • Knowledge of WAN, IoT/Video, Kubernetes, and containerized applications is advantageous.
  • Previous experience with government tenders and Governance, Risk Management, and Compliance (GRC).
  • Experience working with security practitioners, network, application, and database operations personnel.

  • Professional certifications (e.g., CISA, CISM, CISSP, GCIA) are highly desirable.
  • Experience working in client-serving/project-based models

Job Summary – Member of Technical Staff - Agentic AI Architect, Smart Manufacturing AI Pathfinding & Innovation (AIPI)

Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The memory solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

The Smart Manufacturing and AI team at Micron Technology is looking for an ambitious engineer (Member of Technical Staff | MTS) to deliver industry-winning Agentic AI solutions that power Micron’s dominance in the highly competitive memory solutions market. This role sits at the intersection of applied Agentic AI engineering and production systems work: you will architect autonomous AI Agents and the agentic and data pipelines that power them, build robust CI/CD deployment paths to Kubernetes and containers, and push the limits of agent performance profiling and evaluation to turn massive data and compute into measurable manufacturing impact. Qualified applicants will have experience across data/cloud technologies and systems engineering, with extensive practice modeling data, querying, and deploying scalable pipelines to execute AI agents. You will collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers and expert users to build and deploy scalable Agentic AI solutions that drive value and insight from Micron’s manufacturing processes and systems.

If you enjoy solving hard problems at scale, thrive on turning speculative research into production-grade systems, and want to see your work drive silicon to market, this is the team for you.

Responsibilities include, but not limited to:

  • Design and develop autonomous AI Agents capable of multi-step reasoning, planning, and tool execution to automate complex manufacturing workflows.

  • Implement Agentic frameworks to orchestrate LLM interactions with internal APIs, databases, and software tools.

  • Build and maintain agent evaluation harnesses to benchmark agent accuracy, reliability, and task success across complex, multi-step workflows.

  • Analyze and profile agent and inference workloads (e.g., tool-calling latency, multi-agent orchestration) to identify and resolve bottlenecks in compute and latency, using agent observability and profiling tools (e.g., PyTorch Profiler, LangSmith, OpenTelemetry).

  • Implement interoperable multi-agent systems using the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), including MCP tools, plugins, and skills.

  • Create/maintain CI/CD pipelines for deploying AI Agents to Kubernetes and containerized environments in the cloud.

  • Design and implement security controls for autonomous AI Agents, including sandboxing, access control, and mitigation of prompt-injection and tool-misuse risks.

  • Mentor engineers on agentic system design paradigms and optimization techniques.

Education Qualifications:

Technical Degree required (Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field). Ph.D. is a plus.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Experience optimizing inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM) for autonomous AI Agent and LLM workloads.

  • Experience developing GenAI applications and AI Agents using one or more frameworks. Microsoft Agent Framework or Google Agent Development Kit preferred.

  • Proficiency with Large Language Models (LLMs), including prompt engineering, function calling/tool use, and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning.

  • Experience designing and implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, and vector search.

  • Experience building and operating end-to-end systems that automate the testing, evaluation, and deployment of autonomous AI Agents.

  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools, plugins, and skills, and the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol for building interoperable multi-agent systems.

  • Understanding of AI Agent security practices, including sandboxing, access control, and mitigating prompt-injection and tool-misuse risks.

  • Familiarity with machine learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, etc).

  • Strong scripting and programming skills, with software development skills and a desire to work in a cloud environment.

  • 8+ years of relevant industry experience, spanning large-scale data/ML pipelines and/or production Agentic AI systems.

  • Outstanding analytical thinking, interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills.

  • Ability to prioritize and meet critical project timelines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience with Kubernetes for orchestrating containerized applications, including deployment and scaling of AI Agent workloads.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing and coordinating Multi-Agent Systems, including collaboration between specialized agents.

  • Experience designing and operating agent swarms for distributed, parallelized task execution.

  • Experience with agent profiling and evaluation tooling to identify performance regressions and bottlenecks across agent pipelines.

  • Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or CrewAI.

  • Proficiency in TypeScript and/or Rust.

  • Demonstrated ability to study and transform data science prototypes into production solutions.

  • Knowledge of computer vision and/or signal processing, including techniques for classification and feature extraction.

About Micron Technology, Inc.

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.

jobs.api_description_text:
About Lucidya

Lucidya builds an operating system for Agentic customer experience. Our flagship product line is an agentic platform (Agent Studio) where customers build and run AI agents that resolve real customer experience issues across text and voice channels, in Arabic and English.

Role Summary

The AI Tech Lead is the senior hands-on engineer accountable for the quality, reliability and technical direction of the AI layer of our agentic platform. You will set the technical bar for a team of AI engineers who each own an area, and you will write production code yourself. You will need to wear 2 hats, one is the AI hat and the other is leadership

Key Responsibilities

Technical direction

  • Own and be accountable for the AI architecture and harness: model selection, prompting patterns, retrieval design, guardrails and voice pipeline
  • Make and document technical decisions with clear rationale

Quality, evaluation and reliability

  • Define the evaluation standard and move key work from experimentation to production
  • Introduce leading testing frameworks for Agentic development
  • Ensure production monitoring and online evals catch quality drops, hallucinations and latency spikes before customers report them

Team leadership and engineering practices

  • Lead the AI team in designing, developing, and delivering our Agentic Platform
  • Mentor AI engineers, raise the technical bar through pairing and feedback, and contribute to hiring

Hands-on delivery

  • Lead debugging of critical production incidents involving AI behaviour
  • Manage the building of prototypes/experiments to validate new capabilities (new models, agent patterns, voice features) before the team commits to them

Cross-functional partnership

  • Work with Product to turn customer use cases into technical requirements
  • Work with Engineering on shared platform work: tool calling, workflows, deployment and scaling

Mindset and Behaviors

  • Ownership: takes outcomes end to end, including gaps between teams, and follows through without being asked
  • Trade-off judgement: grounds decisions in business needs and can explain the trade-offs between quality, speed and cost
  • Constructive challenge: comfortable questioning existing approaches and proposing better ones
  • Team player: shares credit, helps teammates succeed, and puts team goals ahead of individual wins
  • Creativity and innovation: solve complex challenges with 'out-of-box' thinking and be a champion for innovation

Requirements

  • Experience: 7+ years in software or ML engineering, including 2+ years building LLM-based applications in production. Not just building AI point solutions, AI platform level experience is required
  • Technical leadership: has led a team of 3+ AI engineers/scientist technically (design reviews, standards, mentoring)
  • LLM application engineering: deep hands-on experience with prompting, structured outputs, guardrails, agent patterns/harness development (planning, tool use, multi-step reasoning)
  • Ability to work in ambiguous settings: can bring clarity and structure to complex situations
  • Evaluation: has built LLM evaluation pipelines (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression suites) and used them to gate releases
  • Production engineering: strong Python; experience with APIs, cloud deployment, observability and debugging distributed systems
  • Communication: fluent written and spoken English; able to write clear design docs and decision records

Nice-to-have Qualifications

  • Arabic NLP: experience with Arabic and its dialects, especially Gulf Arabic, in LLM or speech systems
  • Voice AI: experience with ASR, TTS and real-time voice agents, including latency optimisation
  • Production monitoring for LLMs: hands-on use of tracing and online eval tools (for example Langfuse, Arize or similar)
  • Model adaptation: fine-tuning or distilling open-weight models, and serving them cost-effectively

As an AI Engineer who bridges traditional machine learning and modern generative / agentic AI. This role involves designing, building, and deploying end-to-end AI solutions including classical ML models, RAG-based applications, and lightweight agentic workflows. The successful candidate will contribute hands-on to client delivery projects, applying strong Python engineering and statistical rigor to develop scalable AI solutions that work reliably in production environments.

What will you do?

AI / ML Model Development & Deployment

  • Design, build, and deploy end-to-end ML models including classification, regression, time-series, and NLP models.

  • Integrate ML models into production systems and applications.

  • Monitor model performance and conduct analysis to detect data drift, quality issues, and opportunities for improvement.

Generative AI & RAG Application Development

  • Develop GenAI applications including RAG pipelines, prompt-engineered chatbots, and lightweight agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, or Python.

  • Implement effective RAG architectures including chunking strategies, embedding selection, vector store configuration (e.g., Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector), and retrieval evaluation.

Software Engineering & Development Practices

  • Write clean, maintainable, and production-ready Python code.

  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to shared libraries and internal AI platform components.

  • Use Git, CI/CD practices, and containerisation tools such as Docker in development workflows.

Collaboration & Delivery

Research & Innovation

The ideal candidate should possess:

  • 2–5 years of hands-on experience in AI/ML engineering or data science roles
  • Demonstrable track record of delivering at least 2–3 ML projects (beyond notebooks — production or near-production) and 1–2 GenAI / agentic AI projects
  • Strong Python programming skills including Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, and PyTorch or TensorFlow
  • Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals including feature engineering, model evaluation, bias-variance trade-off, and hyperparameter optimisation
  • Hands-on experience building RAG chatbots and applications using LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or equivalent

  • Practical experience with at least one vector database such as Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector, or equivalent
  • Experience with at least one cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP for model training or deployment
  • Proficiency with Git, CI/CD basics, and containerisation (Docker)
  • Ability to read and write at least one additional programming language such as TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Go, or advanced SQL

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience building voice AI bots using a pro-code approach such as Twilio, Amazon Connect, Deepgram, Whisper + TTS pipelines
  • Exposure to agentic patterns such as tool-calling agents, ReAct loops, multi-step planning, or reflection mechanisms
  • Familiarity with MLOps tooling such as MLflow, Weights & Biases (W&B), model registries, or orchestration tools like Airflow, Prefect, or ZenML
  • Experience with evaluation frameworks for RAG and GenAI outputs such as RAGAS, DeepEval, or promptfoo
  • Knowledge of responsible AI principles including bias detection, fairness metrics, and output guardrails
  • Exposure to NLP pipelines including entity extraction, text classification, and summarisation
  • Prior experience in a systems integrator (SI), consultancy, or multi-client delivery environment

Why Join NCS

  • Lead high-impact Data & AI advisory programs for major enterprises and public sector clients.

  • Shape enterprise strategies and governance frameworks that drive real transformation.

  • Work with a talented, multidisciplinary team in a collaborative environment.

  • Competitive compensation and strong professional development support.

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

jobs.api_description_text:
The AI Engineer builds, tests, and iterates production Agentic AI systems at the core of the Autonomous Networks Programme. Working directly with the AI Solution Architect, Business Analyst, and Central Infrastructure Solution Architect, this role turns architecture designs into working code — implementing agent logic, integrating OSS APIs, building RAG pipelines, and deploying agents into staging and production environments.

This is a hands-on engineering and development role where code quality, test rigour, and operational reliability are the primary measures of success.

What will you do?

Technical Delivery

  • Own end-to-end delivery of AI workstreams: from requirements through data preparation, modelling, integration, testing, and production handover
  • Develop agentic applications including RAG pipelines, prompt-engineered agents, and agentic workflows using LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, or plain Python
  • Build on top of GenAI application stacks including LLM orchestration, observability (Langfuse, Braintrust), guardrails, and LLM gateway patterns (LiteLLM, Portkey)
  • Implement multi-agent orchestration layer: event routing, resource locking, inter-agent handoff contracts, prompt caching, and shared state management
  • Implement agentic design patterns including workflow evaluation, LLM-as-Judge, and AI red teaming
  • Adopt Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Protocol as foundational extension mechanisms, enabling agents to operate safely across enterprise ecosystems
  • Work with AI Solution Architect and Business Analysts on benchmarking and golden-set compilation for agent evaluation
  • Implement effective RAG architectures: chunking strategies, embedding selection, vector store configuration (Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector), hybrid search, and reranking
  • Build and maintain evaluation harnesses measuring correctness, faithfulness, latency, and safety. Run continuous LLM-as-Judge evaluation on production traces
  • Write clean, maintainable Python; participate in code reviews; contribute to shared AI platform libraries

OSS Integration & Data Engineering

  • Implement REST, NETCONF/YANG, SNMP trap ingestion, and gNMI streaming telemetry integrations connecting agents to NMS and EMS systems
  • Build ServiceNow integrations for ticket read/write, triage updates, change record queries, and human-in-the-loop approval workflow triggers for the Execution Agent
  • Build the alarm and telemetry data normalisation pipeline converting multi-vendor OSS data into agent-consumable schemas
  • Implement Kafka or equivalent event streaming consumers delivering real-time alarm data to the Alarm Correlation and Ticket Triaging agents
  • Work with data and integration engineers to normalise multi-vendor, multi-format network telemetry into consistent schemas the agents can reason over

Safety, Guardrails & Risk

  • Implement guardrail architectures: hard limits, soft limits with human confirmation flows, blast radius controls, and escalation logic
  • Assist the AI Solution Architect to assess blast radius for each agent — documenting worst-case impacts and designing specific mitigating controls
  • Implement and validate rollback procedures for all agent-initiated network actions, including automated rollback triggers based on post-execution KPI degradation
  • Work with QA engineers to design and test solutions via defined test cases, and review required improvements
  • Ensure all agent architectures comply with IMDA regulatory requirements, AIVerify framework requirements, InfoSec policies, and CMB change governance frameworks

Observability & Evaluation

  • Implement the Decision Audit Trail schema for all agents ensuring every decision is fully traceable, explainable, and available for post-incident review
  • Build the Agent Operations Dashboard for the NOC team: real-time agent status, decision volumes, accuracy metrics, and exception alerts
  • Define and implement the evaluation framework: factual, reasoning, tool-call, retrieval and planning accuracy, confidence thresholds, and human feedback capture
  • Implement continuous evaluation of production agent traces using LLM-as-Judge for quality and safety; design human evaluation sample process
  • Build drift detection mechanisms that alert the team when agent output quality degrades before it becomes an operational incident
  • Containerise and deploy agent services using Docker and CI/CD pipelines; manage staging and production deployments with rollback capability

The ideal candidate should possess:

  • Minimum 3 years of AI/ML engineering experience, with at least 1 year in production Agentic AI systems (not PoC or prototype-only)
  • Demonstrable experience building AI agents that call external tools, manage state, and operate in production environments with real operational consequences
  • Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude) or Open Source LLMs on vLLM (Qwen, Mistral, DeepSeek) in production — including prompt engineering, evaluation, and cost management
  • Experience building RAG pipelines with vector databases (Qdrant, Milvus, Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector) in production, including hybrid search and reranking
  • Practical experience with at least one agentic AI framework: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, or custom tool-calling
  • Strong Python — modular, testable, production-quality code. Proficiency with Git, CI/CD, Docker, and LLMOps practices
  • Full-stack awareness: REST APIs, front-end integration, data pipelines
  • Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, AI/ML, or related technical field

Highly Desirable

  • Experience with Telco, utilities, or other 24×7 critical infrastructure environments where AI system failures have direct operational consequences
  • Familiarity with OSS systems: NMS, EMS, network alarm management, NETCONF/YANG, or gNMI streaming telemetry
  • Experience with event streaming platforms: Apache Kafka, Pulsar, or equivalent
  • Experience integrating with ServiceNow REST API for ITSM data
  • Experience with AI observability tools: Langfuse, Braintrust, LangSmith, Weights & Biases, Prometheus/Grafana
  • Experience implementing AI systems subject to regulatory or formal risk governance frameworks (CMB, InfoSec review, audit requirements)
  • Familiarity with network automation platforms (Cisco NSO, Nokia CloudBand, ONAP) as agent integration targets
  • Familiarity with TM Forum frameworks including the Autonomous Network Maturity Model (L0–L5)
  • Cloud ML platform experience: AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, or Google Vertex AI

Qualifications & Certifications

  • Required: Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, AI/ML, or related technical field
  • Desirable: Professional certifications in Agentic AI development and architecting

The successful candidate will explore emerging technologies, evaluate their enterprise applicability, develop architectural concepts and prototypes, and work across engineering, cybersecurity, data, infrastructure and business teams to move promising capabilities from research to architecture, validation and adoption.


What You'll Do:

AI Technology Research &amp & Foresight

  • Track developments in Generative AI, LLMs and VLMs, AI agents, reasoning models, multimodal AI, retrieval-augmented generation, knowledge graphs, model serving and AI infrastructure.
  • Assess emerging technologies for relevance to SP’s business, operational and technology environment.
  • Conduct structured technology evaluations, experiments and technical deep-dives.
  • Identify opportunities, architecture implications, limitations and risks before enterprise-scale adoption.
  • Translate complex technology developments into clear recommendations for technical and management stakeholders.


Enterprise AI Architecture

  • Define and evolve SP’s AI target architecture, reference architectures and architecture patterns.
  • Develop architecture across AI/ML platforms, LLM and VLM serving, AI agents, RAG and enterprise
  • knowledge, AI Gateway, guardrails, observability, model lifecycle management, MCP/tool integration, and cloud/on-premises AI infrastructure.
  • Ensure AI solutions align with enterprise architecture principles and integrate coherently with data, cloud, cybersecurity and application architectures.


AI Governance, Security & Resilience by Design

  • Embed security, governance, privacy, observability and operational resilience into AI architectures from the outset.
  • Develop patterns for bounded and controlled AI agents, including identity, authorisation, data boundaries, tool permissions, runtime controls and containment.
  • Work with Cybersecurity and Risk teams to translate control requirements into implementable architecture.
  • Assess risks introduced by autonomous and agentic systems and recommend architecture-level mitigations.
  • Contribute to approaches for AI asset registration, monitoring, containment and lifecycle governance.


Cross-Functional Architecture Leadership

  • Partner with business teams to translate operational problems into architecture opportunities.
  • Work with AI Delivery, Data and Software engineering teams to turn architectural concepts into implementable platforms and solutions.
  • Collaborate with Cybersecurity, Risk, Infrastructure and Cloud teams on secure and practical deployment architectures.
  • Present architecture options, trade-offs and recommendations to senior stakeholders and governance forums.
  • Maintain architectural direction while transitioning proven capabilities to engineering and business teams for implementation, adoption and operations.


Required Experience & Capabilities:

Technical Experience

  • Enterprise, solution or platform architecture, with practical experience in AI, data, cloud and hybrid architectures.
  • Generative and multimodal AI, including LLMs/VLMs, AI agents, RAG, vector search, knowledge graphs and model serving.
  • AI/ML platforms and lifecycle management, including model deployment, evaluation, observability, guardrails and AI security.
  • Cloud and on-premises infrastructure, including APIs, enterprise integration, containers, Kubernetes, identity, zero-trust security and GPU-based AI workloads.
  • Practical familiarity with technologies such as Azure AI, Databricks, Cloudera AI, NVIDIA GPU platforms, MLflow, LangChain/LangGraph, MCP, vector/graph databases and open-source AI ecosystems would be advantageous.


Architecture & Research Skills

  • Ability to quickly understand unfamiliar technologies and distinguish meaningful potential from vendor hype.
  • Ability to move between conceptual architecture and hands-on experimentation.
  • Strong systems thinking across models, agents, data, infrastructure, identity, cybersecurity, governance and operations.
  • Ability to analyse trade-offs and translate experiments into enterprise patterns and standards.
  • Clear communication through architecture diagrams, technical papers, decision papers and executive presentations.
  • Ability to influence across teams without becoming the permanent owner of every delivery activity.


What You'll Need:

  • Approximately 5 or more years of relevant technology experience, with substantial exposure to architecture, AI/data platforms, software engineering or emerging technologies.
  • Experience designing enterprise-scale technology solutions.
  • Practical exposure to modern AI and Generative AI technologies.
  • Experience conducting proofs of concept, technology evaluations or architecture assessments.
  • Curious and proactive, with the ability to explore technologies and identify opportunities before requirements are fully formed.
  • Hands-on but architectural, with the ability to prototype sufficiently to understand a technology while remaining focused on reusable enterprise patterns.
  • Systems-oriented, with an understanding of how AI models, agents, data, platforms, security controls and operating processes interact.
  • Technology-agnostic, with the ability to objectively compare commercial, cloud, on-premises and open-source approaches.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, with the ability to structure exploratory questions and convert them into testable hypotheses and recommendations.
  • Collaborative and influential, with the ability to work across Business, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Risk, Infrastructure and governance forums.
  • Experience in utilities, critical infrastructure, regulated industries or similarly security-conscious environments would be advantageous.

jobs.api_description_text:
We are looking for a Senior Agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) to lead the development of next-generation AI agents capable of autonomously executing complex, long-horizon tasks across virtual environments.

This is an exciting opportunity to drive cutting-edge LLM post-training and Agent RL, working on advanced techniques such as GRPO/PPO, trajectory-based training, and sandbox environment integration. You will lead a team to push the boundaries of agent autonomy, reliability, and task completion, turning advanced AI research into real-world capabilities.

Job Responsibilities

  • Conduct reinforcement learning (RL) training experiments for long-horizon tasks, including hyperparameter tuning, performance analysis, and iterative optimization.
  • Manage agent trajectory data feedback and integration into the training pipeline, as well as coordinate and optimize sandbox environment integration.
  • Work closely with the evaluation team to validate model capabilities, analyze evaluation results, and continuously improve the model's success rate on long-horizon tasks.

Requirements

  • Master's degree or above, with at least 3 years of hands-on experience in Reinforcement Learning (RL), Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), or Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). Experience in Agent-related projects is preferred.
  • Familiarity with mainstream RL algorithms such as GRPO and PPO, as well as LLM training frameworks such as veRL and OpenRLHF.
  • Experience leading a small team, with a proven track record of delivering end-to-end LLM post-training projects.

jobs.api_description_text:
What will you do:

Design, build, and operate production-grade agentic and GenAI systems—end to end. You’ll ship services (not just notebooks): robust APIs, reusable components, and secure pipelines that connect LLMs, tools, knowledge, and enterprise systems. You’ll pair strong software engineering with modern AI practices (RAG, agent orchestration, policy chains, evals) to deliver measurable business outcomes at scale.

1. Agent & Application Engineering

  • Design multi-agent systems (MAS) with planning, tool-use, and delegation (e.g., LangGraph/Semantic Kernel); expose them via REST/gRPC APIs (FastAPI/Express/Java/Go).
  • Implement tool adapters (SQL, search, document stores, web calls, code exec) with strict type contracts and safe sandboxes.
  • Build model gateway integrations (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI/Bedrock/Vertex; self-hosted vLLM/TGI) with routing, rate-limits, retries, and fallback chains.

2. Retrieval, Data & Knowledge

  • Stand up RAG services: chunking, enrichment, embeddings, indexing, hybrid/vector search (pgvector/Pinecone/Weaviate; OpenSearch/Azure AI Search).
  • Implement ingestion pipelines (Airflow/Prefect/Celery/Ray) for docs, tickets, chat, and ERP/CRM data; handle PII redaction and metadata governance.
  • Optimize retrieval quality (chunking strategies, re-rankers, query rewriting) with offline/online evaluation and A/B tests.

3. Quality, Testing & Evaluation

  • Treat prompts and graphs as code: version, diff, and test them (unit tests for prompts/tools; golden sets; regression suites).
  • Build evaluation harnesses (latency, cost, accuracy, toxicity, hallucination, guardrail hit-rates); wire into CI.
  • Add drift detection for conversational systems; implement safe shutdown and auto-rollback.

4. Platform & Operations

  • Package services as containers; deploy to Kubernetes with Helm/Argo CD; configure autoscaling, HPA/VPA, and resource quotas.
  • Implement policy chains and guardrails (OPA/Gatekeeper for policy, Presidio for PII, Trivy for image scanning).
  • Instrument deep observability: tracing (OpenTelemetry), metrics (Prometheus), logs (ELK/OPENSEARCH), cost meters per request/model.

5. Security & Compliance

  • Manage secrets (HashiCorp Vault/KMS), signed images, SBOMs; enforce least-privilege IAM.
  • Build tenant isolation and data residency controls; implement red/blue team prompts and jailbreak defenses.

6. Integration & Enterprise Workflows

  • Ship connectors and events for SAP/CRM/ITSM and Kafka topics; design idempotent, retry-safe processors.
  • Automate business workflows with pro-code services first; expose low-code surfaces only where appropriate.

7. Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner with Product, Data, and Platform teams to define SLAs/SLOs and success metrics.
  • Mentor engineers on “AI as software” practices; run design reviews and postmortems.

The ideal candidate should possess:

  • 6+ years in software engineering (prod services, not just prototypes), including 1+ year leading small projects.
  • Strong in one systems language (Python/TypeScript/Go/Java) and comfortable in a second.
  • Hands-on with containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD (GitHub Actions/GitLab/Jenkins), IaC (Terraform), and cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP).
  • Practical LLM experience: building RAG/agent apps, prompt design, tool-use, and safety patterns.
  • Data skills: designing schemas, batch/stream pipelines, and search indexes; proficiency with SQL and one vector DB.
  • Testing mindset: unit/integration tests, load tests, golden datasets for LLM evals.
  • Security basics: secrets, policies, scanning, and least-privilege IAM.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Agent orchestration (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel) and distributed compute (Ray) in production.
  • Search/retrieval tuning (BM25 + vector hybrid, re-ranking, query planning).
  • Observability at scale with OpenTelemetry; cost/perf optimization across model/router layers.
  • Experience in regulated or high-throughput domains (e.g., telco, finance, healthcare); multi-tenant and data-residency patterns.
  • Domain integrations (SAP/CRM/ITSM), event-driven architectures (Kafka/Debezium), and policy enforcement (OPA/Gatekeeper).
  • Familiarity with TM Forum APIs / BSS-OSS patterns is a plus (if in telco context).

Tech Stack (Illustrative)

  • Languages: Python, TypeScript/Node.js (plus Go/Java bonus)
  • Frameworks: FastAPI/Express, LangGraph/Semantic Kernel, Ray/Celery, Airflow/Prefect
  • Storage/Search: Postgres, Redis, S3/Blob; pgvector/Pinecone/Weaviate; OpenSearch/Azure AI Search
  • LLM Runtime: OpenAI/Azure OpenAI/Bedrock/Vertex; vLLM/TGI; inference routers/gateways
  • Platform: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD, Terraform, Vault, Istio
  • Observability: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch
  • Quality & Safety: pytest/Jest, prompt/unit test harnesses, guardrails, Presidio, Trivy

Why Join NCS

  • Lead high-impact Data & AI advisory programs for major enterprises and public sector clients.

  • Shape enterprise strategies and governance frameworks that drive real transformation.

  • Work with a talented, multidisciplinary team in a collaborative environment.

  • Competitive compensation and strong professional development support.

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

You will lead end-to-end delivery of AI workstreams, design and build advanced agentic AI solutions, and serve as the credible technical face of NCS AI capabilities in client engagements. Beyond your strong hands-on AI engineering capabilities, you will lead small technical teams, engage clients with confidence, translate business problems into sound AI architectures, and mentor junior engineers. You will own delivery workstreams, guide your squad, and drive the successful implementation of next-generation AI-powered solutions across government, telco, financial services, and e-commerce sectors.

What Will You Do?

Technical Delivery & AI Solution Development

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of AI workstreams from requirements through data preparation, modelling, integration, testing, and production handover
  • Design and build advanced agentic AI solutions including multi-agent systems, RAG pipelines with AI memory, planning and reasoning loops, and reflection patterns
  • Architect GenAI application stacks including LLM orchestration layers, observability tools (Langfuse, Braintrust), guardrails, and LLM gateway patterns (LiteLLM, Portkey)
  • Develop production-grade ML systems alongside GenAI components, maintaining quality across both paradigms
  • Design, build, and deploy end-to-end ML models (classification, regression, time-series, NLP) and integrate them into production systems
  • Develop GenAI applications including RAG pipelines, prompt-engineered chatbots, and lightweight agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, or plain Python
  • Implement effective RAG architectures including chunking strategies, embedding selection, vector store configuration (Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector), and retrieval evaluation
  • Build and maintain evaluation harnesses for AI system quality — correctness, faithfulness, latency, and safety

Engineering Excellence & Quality Assurance

  • Conduct technical code reviews, enforce engineering standards, and introduce tooling that improves team velocity
  • Write clean, maintainable Python code; participate in code reviews; contribute to shared libraries and internal AI platform components
  • Design multi-component AI architectures and communicate them via clear diagrams and written specifications

Client & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Serve as a primary technical point of contact for client teams in day-to-day delivery interactions
  • Lead or co-facilitate client workshops including requirements discovery, solution walkthroughs, sprint demos, and retrospectives
  • Translate ambiguous client requirements into well-defined technical user stories and acceptance criteria
  • Communicate technical trade-offs and design decisions in clear, accessible language appropriate for business stakeholders
  • Manage client expectations proactively, surface risks early, and propose mitigations

Team Leadership & Mentorship

  • Technically lead a small squad of 2–4 AI engineers; delegate tasks, review outputs, and coach on best practices

Required Experience & Background

Core Technical Competencies

  • Strong Python programming with Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow; comfortable writing modular, testable code

  • Hands-on GenAI experience building RAG chatbots and applications, working with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or equivalent)
  • Familiarity with vector databases and embedding models for semantic search and retrieval (e.g., Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector)
  • Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for model training or deployment
  • Proficiency with Git, CI/CD, and containerisation (Docker); familiarity with MLOps practices
  • Proficiency in at least one additional programming language beyond Python (e.g., TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Go, or advanced SQL)
  • Deep hands-on experience with agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or OpenAI Agents SDK
  • Experience with LLM observability, evaluation, and guardrails tooling in production environments
  • Comfort with multiple programming languages and full-stack awareness (APIs, front-end integration, data pipelines)
  • Working knowledge of MLOps and AI infrastructure including model serving, monitoring, and CI/CD for AI systems

Client Engagement & Communication Skills

jobs.api_description_text:
As an AI Solution Architect, you will be the technical authority responsible for designing, architecting, and guiding the delivery of Agentic AI systems within the Autonomous Networks Programme. You will work closely with the Project Director, Network SMEs, OSS engineers, NOC operations teams, and the Central AI Infrastructure Solution Architect to translate network operations challenges into production-grade AI agent solutions that are safe, explainable, trusted, and operationally effective. This is a hands-on role requiring both strong architecture leadership and practical engineering capability, including prototyping, coding, system integration, and technical review.

What will you do?

Agent Architecture & Design

  • Lead the end-to-end architecture of Agentic AI systems, covering data ingestion, reasoning, decision-making, action execution, and audit logging.
  • Define agent scope, decision boundaries, tool specifications, and autonomy levels in alignment with programme stakeholders.
  • Design multi-agent orchestration capabilities such as event routing, resource locking, inter-agent handoff contracts, prompt caching, and shared state management.
  • Architect RAG pipelines for knowledge and diagnosis agents, including corpus design, chunking strategy, embedding model selection, retrieval design, and evaluation methodology.
  • Design agentic workflows, evaluation patterns, hybrid search, reranking strategies, benchmarking approaches, and golden datasets.
  • Develop prompt templates, output schemas, hallucination guardrails, and confidence scoring mechanisms for LLM-based agents.
  • Produce and own technical design artefacts including architecture decision records (ADRs), sequence diagrams, data flow diagrams, and agent logic flowcharts.

OSS Integration & Data Engineering

  • Adopt and apply Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent protocol patterns as governed extension mechanisms for enterprise AI agents.
  • Design and build data pipeline layers that normalise multi-vendor, multi-format network telemetry into usable schemas for AI reasoning.
  • Work with the Network Solution Architect to define integration patterns between AI agents and OSS platforms such as NMS, EMS, ServiceNow ITSM, inventory, and provisioning systems through REST APIs.
  • Design event streaming architecture, such as Kafka or equivalent, to support near real-time alarm and telemetry processing aligned to NOC latency requirements.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to improve the quality of alarm, ticket, and inventory data that supports agent accuracy and reliability.

Safety, Guardrails & Risk Architecture

  • Design and implement guardrails for all agents, including hard limits, human confirmation flows, blast radius controls, and escalation logic.
  • Lead blast radius assessments with Network SMEs and Risk teams, documenting worst-case impacts and defining mitigating controls.
  • Design and validate rollback procedures for agent-initiated actions, including KPI-based automated rollback triggers.
  • Ensure solution architectures comply with IMDA requirements, AIVerify expectations, InfoSec policies, and relevant change governance processes.

Observability & Evaluation

  • Design decision audit trail schemas to ensure all agent actions and decisions are traceable, explainable, and reviewable.
  • Define continuous evaluation approaches for production agent traces using LLM-as-judge and human review samples.
  • Build or guide the development of Agent Operations Dashboards for NOC teams, showing agent health, decision activity, accuracy, and exceptions.
  • Define agent evaluation frameworks across factual accuracy, reasoning quality, retrieval performance, planning quality, tool-call accuracy, and confidence thresholds.
  • Design drift detection mechanisms to identify output quality degradation before operational impact occurs.

Delivery & Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Partner with the Project Director on design planning, sprint planning, design governance, and build readiness.
  • Work with Network SME owners to validate architectural decisions against real operational workflows and constraints.
  • Lead technical walkthroughs with NOC management and Central AI Infrastructure leadership to build confidence in the proposed architecture.
  • Provide mentorship and technical guidance to AI/ML engineers and integration engineers through code reviews, architecture reviews, and design support.
  • Translate technical decisions into clear, concise, non-technical summaries for programme leadership and steering committees.

The ideal candidate should possess:

Required / Mandatory experience

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in AI/ML engineering or application solution architecture.
  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience in production Agentic AI systems, beyond proof-of-concept or prototype work.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and deploying AI agents that use external tools, manage state, and operate in production environments.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM APIs such as OpenAI or Anthropic Claude, or with open-source LLMs on vLLM such as Qwen, Mistral, or DeepSeek.
  • Strong experience in prompt engineering, evaluation design, and cost management for production AI systems.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing RAG pipelines with vector databases such as Milvus, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector, or equivalent.
  • Experience integrating AI systems with enterprise operational platforms such as ITSM, monitoring, streaming, or telemetry systems.
  • Ability to write code, build prototypes, and review pull requests as part of hands-on delivery.

Highly desirable experience

  • Experience in Telco, utilities, or other 24×7 critical infrastructure environments.
  • Familiarity with OSS platforms and protocols such as NMS, EMS, network alarm management, NETCONF/YANG, or gNMI streaming telemetry.
  • Experience designing AI systems under regulatory, audit, security, and formal risk governance requirements.
  • Experience with network automation platforms such as Cisco NSO, Nokia CloudBand, or ONAP.
  • Familiarity with TM Forum Autonomous Network Maturity Model (L0–L5).
  • Working knowledge of frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph.

Desirable certifications

  • Microsoft Certified Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect
  • AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional
  • AWS Machine Learning Specialty
  • Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer

Education qualification

  • Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, AI/ML, or a related technical field.

AI Solution Development

  • Strong experience integrating APIs, databases and enterprise systems, with sound system design and architecture skills.
  • In-depth knowledge of vector databases, semantic search, prompt engineering and LLM evaluation techniques.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD and container technologies (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes) in production environments.

Preferred Skills:

Industrial AI Application Engineer

About the role

Work on site with our customers' engineering and operations teams to turn cutting-edge AI into working solutions on the factory floor. You will own each use case end to end, from the operational problem and raw plant data to deploying and scaling ML and agentic AI on-premises or in the cloud.

You'll make a difference by

  • Build data and knowledge pipelines: Ingest, clean and contextualise sensor and time-series data and unstructured documents for analytics, model training and retrieval.
  • Build agentic and LLM applications: Develop AI agents with planning, memory, tool use and RAG, including long-horizon agents for tasks such as root-cause analysis.
  • Architect end-to-end AI systems: Design scalable, secure stacks spanning databases, microservices, APIs and user applications.
  • Ensure quality and reliability: Define evaluation metrics, guardrails and monitoring for models and agents in safety-critical settings.
  • Operationalise AI: Run MLOps/LLMOps pipelines, monitor drift, manage retraining, and optimise latency, cost and accuracy across edge, on-premises and cloud.
  • Size and serve LLMs: Serve LLMs across multiple GPUs and servers, and translate customer requirements into accurate GPU and server sizing.
  • Be the customer's trusted AI expert: Turn complex AI into practical recommendations for engineering, operations and business stakeholders.

Your defining qualities

  • Proven industrial AI deployment: 5+ years in Data Science, AI or ML, with confirmed hands-on experience deploying AI into live operation in plants, fabs or facilities. You can walk us through specific deployments, your role and the results.
  • Data preparation: Cleaning, validating and feature engineering for noisy, incomplete real-world data, including time-series and sensor data.
  • AI agents for data cleaning: Proven experience building agents that automate data profiling and cleaning (missing values, outliers, unit and timestamp issues, tag-to-asset mapping), with validation checks and human review.
  • Model training and tuning: Cross-validation, loss selection, regularisation and hyperparameter tuning (grid, random, Bayesian).
  • Mathematical and research-driven thinking: Strong grasp of the maths behind ML and neural networks; able to frame industrial problems such as root-cause analysis mathematically, implement algorithms from research papers and prove feasibility through controlled experiments.
  • Production LLM serving and sizing: Multi-GPU serving, continuous batching, KV-cache management and quantisation; able to estimate GPU memory, throughput and cost, and load-test against latency targets.
  • Industrial domain exposure: Production, process, equipment or facility data in semiconductor, pharmaceutical, chemical, FMCG or other advanced manufacturing.
  • Self-starter with engineering rigour: Curious and accountable; verifies every part of a solution, including AI-assisted code, and explains trade-offs clearly to technical and business audiences.
  • Education: Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, AI, Engineering, Automation or a related field.

Technologies you should be familiar with

  • Core AI/ML: Python, PyTorch, NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, transformer architectures
  • Time-series AI: Time-series foundation models (e.g. Chronos, TimesFM, Moirai), statsmodels, sktime, Darts
  • Agents and retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, RAG, vector databases, function calling, MCP
  • LLM serving: vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server / NVIDIA NIM, Ray
  • LLM adaptation: Hugging Face Transformers, LoRA/QLoRA, quantisation (FP8, AWQ, GPTQ)
  • Data and backend: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Neo4j, Kafka, FastAPI
  • Deployment and MLOps: Docker, Kubernetes (NVIDIA GPU Operator), Azure / AWS / Google Cloud, MLflow, LangSmith
  • Industrial data: Time-series databases, OPC UA, MQTT

Nice to have

  • Unstructured data and RAG: Document parsing, OCR, chunking, embeddings and retrieval evaluation.
  • Time-series AI: Forecasting, anomaly detection and drift handling, plus how time-series foundation models work and when to use them.
  • Advanced agentic AI: Multi-agent orchestration, long-horizon agents (state persistence, error recovery, human-in-the-loop) and agent evaluation.
  • Software and system design: Production-grade Python, CI/CD, and full-stack design with microservices, databases and event-driven integration.
  • Advanced LLM training: SFT, RLHF/DPO, or adapting LLMs to industrial domains.
  • Predictive maintenance or computer vision for visual inspection.
  • OT and AI cybersecurity: IEC 62443, network segmentation, secure AI deployment and LLM risks such as prompt injection; GICSP, GRID or ISA/IEC 62443 certification is a plus.
  • Large-scale distributed computing: Multi-node inference or training on GPU clusters (NVLink, InfiniBand), or edge deployment.

Our main product, EPOS360, brings point of sale, payments, online selling, loyalty, and AI-powered business insights into one merchant platform. We help restaurants, cafés, retailers, and other small businesses simplify daily operations and find opportunities to grow.


The opportunity

You’ll shape the roadmap for conversational experiences, improve messaging and customer journeys, and lead the go-to-market initiatives that bring them to market. Chat experiences and conversion.

jobs.api_description_text:
About Us

We are the Cyber Security Group (CSG) of the Government Technology Agency of Singapore (GovTech). CSG safeguards the Government's ICT systems and digital services, so that citizens and businesses can trust the services they rely on.

Our team builds security products for use across the Whole-of-Government. We are engineers and security practitioners building AI agents that test government systems the way an attacker would, so that weaknesses are found and fixed before they can be exploited.

About The Role

You will build agentic offensive security tools: AI agents that find, validate and exploit vulnerabilities in applications, source code, cloud environments and infrastructure, the way a skilled red teamer would.

You are first and foremost a strong software engineer. You also know how attackers work, well enough to teach an agent to think like one. And you have built agentic applications before, so you know what it takes to make them reliable in production.

This is an applied AI role. You will build on top of large language models, not train them.

What you will do

  • Design and build production agentic systems that carry out security testing autonomously, covering planning, tool use, memory and multi-agent orchestration.
  • Turn attacker tradecraft into agent capability: translate attack techniques into tools, prompts, workflows and decision logic.
  • Build the tooling agents rely on, such as exploit harnesses, sandboxed execution environments, browser and API automation, and code analysis.
  • Build evaluation harnesses and benchmarks that measure how well agents find real vulnerabilities, how many false positives they raise, and what each run costs.
  • Reproduce and triage what the agents report, then feed the lessons back into the system.
  • Build in the controls that keep agents safe to run: target scoping, guardrails, human approval points and audit logging.
  • Ship and operate the software end to end: services, APIs, user interfaces, CI/CD, tests and observability.
  • Use AI coding assistants and agents in your own daily work, and raise the team's practice in doing so.
  • Lead technical design, review code and mentor other engineers.
  • Keep current with new attack techniques and with developments in LLMs and agent tooling.

What we are looking for

Software engineering

  • At least 5 years of professional software engineering experience, building and operating production systems.
  • Strong in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript.
  • Solid grounding in backend services, APIs, data stores, containers and CI/CD, on at least one major cloud platform.
  • Good engineering habits: automated testing, code review, clear system design and documentation.

Agentic AI

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping at least one agentic or LLM-powered application.
  • Practical command of the building blocks: tool calling, context management, multi-step orchestration, structured outputs and agent protocols such as MCP.
  • Experience evaluating LLM systems, including writing evals, iterating on prompts and managing cost and latency.
  • Awareness of how these systems fail, including hallucination, non-determinism and prompt injection, and how to design around it.
  • Routine use of AI tools in your own engineering workflow.

Offensive security

  • Working knowledge of attack techniques across all four domains below, with hands-on experience in at least two.
  • Web and API: OWASP Top 10, authentication and authorisation flaws, injection, SSRF and business logic abuse.
  • Whitebox testing: reading source code to find vulnerabilities, trace them to an entry point and prove they are exploitable.
  • Cloud: IAM misconfiguration, privilege escalation and service abuse on AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Infrastructure and red team operations: network attacks, Active Directory, lateral movement, command and control, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Ability to write proof-of-concept exploits and explain findings clearly to engineers.

Good to have

  • Time spent on a penetration testing or red team.
  • Offensive security certifications such as OSCP or OSWE.
  • A track record in CTFs, bug bounty programmes or published CVEs.
  • Contributions to open-source security or agent tooling.
  • Experience securing AI systems themselves, such as agent sandboxing and prompt injection defence.
  • Front-end experience with a modern framework such as React

Singaporeans only.
